{\footnotesize\ttfamily \mbox{\hyperlink{interfaceenum}{enum}} \mbox{\hyperlink{ieee80211_8h_ab88a1881a985504f73aa586698301432}{ieee80211\+\_\+he\+\_\+mcs\+\_\+support}}}

enum ieee80211\+\_\+he\+\_\+mcs\+\_\+support -\/ HE M\+CS support definitions @\+I\+E\+E\+E80211\+\_\+\+H\+E\+\_\+\+M\+C\+S\+\_\+\+S\+U\+P\+P\+O\+R\+T\+\_\+0\+\_\+7\+: M\+C\+Ses 0-\/7 are supported for the number of streams @\+I\+E\+E\+E80211\+\_\+\+H\+E\+\_\+\+M\+C\+S\+\_\+\+S\+U\+P\+P\+O\+R\+T\+\_\+0\+\_\+9\+: M\+C\+Ses 0-\/9 are supported @\+I\+E\+E\+E80211\+\_\+\+H\+E\+\_\+\+M\+C\+S\+\_\+\+S\+U\+P\+P\+O\+R\+T\+\_\+0\+\_\+11\+: M\+C\+Ses 0-\/11 are supported @\+I\+E\+E\+E80211\+\_\+\+H\+E\+\_\+\+M\+C\+S\+\_\+\+N\+O\+T\+\_\+\+S\+U\+P\+P\+O\+R\+T\+ED\+: This number of streams isn\textquotesingle{}t supported

These definitions are used in each 2-\/bit subfield of the rx\+\_\+mcs\+\_\+$\ast$ and tx\+\_\+mcs\+\_\+$\ast$ fields of \&struct \mbox{\hyperlink{structieee80211__he__mcs__nss__supp}{ieee80211\+\_\+he\+\_\+mcs\+\_\+nss\+\_\+supp}}, which are both split into 8 subfields by number of streams. These values indicate which M\+C\+Ses are supported for the number of streams the value appears for. \begin{DoxyEnumFields}{Enumerator}

{\footnotesize\ttfamily \mbox{\hyperlink{interfaceenum}{enum}} \mbox{\hyperlink{ieee80211_8h_a8c47ff004f694b8bd54c5705f01da5cb}{ieee80211\+\_\+root\+\_\+mode\+\_\+identifier}}}

enum ieee80211\+\_\+root\+\_\+mode\+\_\+identifier -\/ root mesh S\+TA mode identifier

These attribute are used by dot11\+Mesh\+H\+W\+M\+P\+Root\+Mode to set root mesh S\+TA mode

@\+I\+E\+E\+E80211\+\_\+\+R\+O\+O\+T\+M\+O\+D\+E\+\_\+\+N\+O\+\_\+\+R\+O\+OT\+: the mesh S\+TA is not a root mesh S\+TA (default) @\+I\+E\+E\+E80211\+\_\+\+R\+O\+O\+T\+M\+O\+D\+E\+\_\+\+R\+O\+OT\+: the mesh S\+TA is a root mesh S\+TA if greater than this value @\+I\+E\+E\+E80211\+\_\+\+P\+R\+O\+A\+C\+T\+I\+V\+E\+\_\+\+P\+R\+E\+Q\+\_\+\+N\+O\+\_\+\+P\+R\+EP\+: the mesh S\+TA is a root mesh S\+TA supports the proactive P\+R\+EQ with proactive P\+R\+EP subfield set to 0 @\+I\+E\+E\+E80211\+\_\+\+P\+R\+O\+A\+C\+T\+I\+V\+E\+\_\+\+P\+R\+E\+Q\+\_\+\+W\+I\+T\+H\+\_\+\+P\+R\+EP\+: the mesh S\+TA is a root mesh S\+TA supports the proactive P\+R\+EQ with proactive P\+R\+EP subfield set to 1 @\+I\+E\+E\+E80211\+\_\+\+P\+R\+O\+A\+C\+T\+I\+V\+E\+\_\+\+R\+A\+NN\+: the mesh S\+TA is a root mesh S\+TA supports the proactive R\+A\+NN \begin{DoxyEnumFields}{Enumerator}

for\+\_\+each\+\_\+element\+\_\+completed -\/ determine if element parsing consumed all data @element\+: element pointer after \mbox{\hyperlink{ieee80211_8h_ab56c84d2566e9dd7a6546e5add5eca6d}{for\+\_\+each\+\_\+element()}} or friends @data\+: same data pointer as passed to \mbox{\hyperlink{ieee80211_8h_ab56c84d2566e9dd7a6546e5add5eca6d}{for\+\_\+each\+\_\+element()}} or friends @datalen\+: same data length as passed to \mbox{\hyperlink{ieee80211_8h_ab56c84d2566e9dd7a6546e5add5eca6d}{for\+\_\+each\+\_\+element()}} or friends

This function returns true if all the data was parsed or considered while walking the elements. Only use this if your \mbox{\hyperlink{ieee80211_8h_ab56c84d2566e9dd7a6546e5add5eca6d}{for\+\_\+each\+\_\+element()}} loop cannot be broken out of, otherwise it always returns false.

If some data was malformed, this returns false since the last parsed element will not fill the whole remaining data. \mbox{\Hypertarget{ieee80211_8h_a3553ab9cfb7676fb9fd4195daaa3f6bd}\label{ieee80211_8h_a3553ab9cfb7676fb9fd4195daaa3f6bd}}

ieee80211\+\_\+get\+\_\+vht\+\_\+max\+\_\+nss -\/ return max N\+SS for a given bandwidth/\+M\+CS @cap\+: V\+HT capabilities of the peer @bw\+: bandwidth to use @mcs\+: M\+CS index to use @ext\+\_\+nss\+\_\+bw\+\_\+capable\+: indicates whether or not the local transmitter (rate scaling algorithm) can deal with the new logic (dot11\+V\+H\+T\+Extended\+N\+S\+S\+B\+W\+Capable) @max\+\_\+vht\+\_\+nss\+: current maximum N\+SS as advertised by the S\+TA in operating mode notification, can be 0 in which case the capability data will be used to derive this (from M\+CS support)

Due to the V\+HT Extended N\+SS Bandwidth Support, the maximum N\+SS can vary for a given B\+W/\+M\+CS. This function parses the data.

\doxysubsubsection{\texorpdfstring{variable}{variable}}
{\footnotesize\ttfamily \+:the variable}

@type\+: the type of the parameter @perm\+: visibility in sysfs

core\+\_\+param is just like \mbox{\hyperlink{moduleparam_8h_abbf8d03e94188bad19d66b79dc261ee5}{module\+\_\+param()}}, but cannot be modular and doesn\textquotesingle{}t add a prefix (such as \char`\"{}printk.\char`\"{}). This is for compatibility with \mbox{\hyperlink{include_2linux_2init_8h_aa0dc36ac15b9944f99175fe21338e90c}{\+\_\+\+\_\+setup()}}, and it makes sense as truly core parameters aren\textquotesingle{}t tied to the particular file they\textquotesingle{}re in.
